info.name: Hugging Face Inference API
info.description:
Run inference on 200,000+ machine learning models hosted on the Hugging Face Hub with a simple HTTP request. Supports text generation, image classification, object detection, speech recognition, and many more tasks.

Contact Support:
 Name: Hugging Face Support
